The Role
In this role, you will manage a team of 10+ engineers who perform ergonomic virtual assessments and validate ergonomic standards and requirements for all global product programs across General Motors. You will be part of the Technical Center India (TCI) ME Ergonomics team. This is a key role interfacing with both regional and global teams.
The team members will execute, analyze, and deliver ergonomic simulations with the desired quality and on-time delivery (OTD). They are required to learn and use GMs digital human modeling tools, and leverage lessons learned from other new product programs and manufacturing plants to support decision-making. Lead the selling and delivery of cutting-edge AI projects in the Life Sciences R&D space, with a core focus on Clinical Development Optimization. Partner with clients, data scientists, engineers, and domain experts to operationalize AI-enabled solutions, including foundation AI simulation capabilities. Drive project execution, client engagement, and contribute to the growth of AI consulting capabilities within Pharma R&D.

Job Responsibility:

  • Support and contribute to the sales cycle, including opportunity shaping, proposal development, client presentations, and solution design.
  • Act as a trusted day-to-day advisor to client stakeholders across Pharma and Life Sciences organizations.
  • Identify opportunities where AI-driven simulation and optimization can deliver measurable value in Clinical R&D.
  • Lead the delivery of innovative AI projects, including emerging and first-in-class AI solutions.
  • Develop compelling client narratives and value propositions around AI capabilities.
  • Own project execution, ensuring quality, timelines, and client satisfaction.
  • Lead cross-functional teams comprising consultants, data scientists, engineers, and clinical experts.

  • Design and implement scalable AI solutions across clinical development use cases.
  • Collaborate with technology partners across AI, cloud, and analytics ecosystems.
  • Support capability development, mentoring, and thought leadership activities.
  • Foster an agile, collaborative, and impact-driven project culture.

Technical/Required Skills:

  • Strong experience delivering AI/ML and analytics-driven consulting engagements.
  • Knowledge of supervised learning, unsupervised learning, Generative AI, LLMs, and Agentic AI.
  • Experience working with clinical trial data, real-world data (RWD), omics, and structured/unstructured datasets.
  • Consulting and client stakeholder management experience.
  • Project leadership and team management skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in ambiguous and fast-paced environments.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Understanding of AI solution architecture and deployment.

Good to have Skills/Experience:

  • Experience with top-tier consulting firms.
  • Exposure to Real-World Evidence (RWE), trial optimization, and biomarker-related use cases.

  • Experience with AWS, Azure ML, Databricks, and foundation model ecosystems.

  • Exposure to agentic AI frameworks and modern AI development workflows.
  • Experience contributing to thought leadership, publications, and industry presentations.

Educational Qualification:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Analytics, or a related field.
  • Advanced degree (MBA, MS, PhD) preferred.

Job Description

Job Title: AI Lead - Capability Development
Function: Learning & Development (L&D)


Job Summary

The AI Lead - Capability Development owns the end-to-end strategy, design, and execution of the organization's AI
upskilling and workforce transformation agenda. This role sits at the intersection of Learning & Development, AI
Business/Alliance teams, and Delivery organizations -translating partner ecosystem commitments (e.g., OpenAI,
Anthropic, and other AI/LLM providers) into a scalable, measurable capability-building engine.
The role is accountable for building the talent pipeline via certification pipeline (e.g., partner-led programs and
internal capability tracks), lateral & campus upskilling/cross-skilling- driving cross-functional stakeholder alignment,
designing curriculum with business relevance, demonstrating ROI on L&D investment, and managing a team and
portfolio of concurrent capability-building initiatives.
This is a strategic-cum-execution role -the person will need to operate as a thought partner to leadership while
remaining hands-on with curriculum design, program delivery, and reporting.


Key Responsibilities

1. AI Strategy & Workforce Transformation

- Define and own the organization's AI capability-building roadmap, aligned to enterprise AI strategy,
partner commitments, and evolving market/client demand for AI-skilled talent.
- Translate leadership commitments (e.g., "100 certifications," partner-tier requirements, FDE pod
readiness) into structured, time-bound workforce transformation programs.
- Continuously scan the external AI talent and certification landscape to keep the internal roadmap
current and competitive.
- Segment the workforce by role archetype and define differentiated AI fluency and specialization
pathways for each.
- Drive change management and adoption strategy to embed AI capability as a core organizational
competency, not a one-time training event.


2. Stakeholder Management

- Serve as the primary L&D interface to senior stakeholders across Business Units, Growth/Partnerships,
Delivery Leadership, HRBPs, and external partner teams
- Manage expectations and commitments made by leadership (e.g., certification numbers, timelines) by
translating them into deliverable execution plans, and proactively flag risks/blockers.
- Build and maintain governance rhythm (steering committees, monthly/quarterly reviews) with
Business Unit heads, Practice Leads, and Executive Sponsors to report progress, risks, and course
corrections.
- Act as a trusted advisor to leadership on capability gaps, talent readiness, and workforce risk related to
AI adoption.
- Manage external partner relationships ( license utilization tracking, escalations on training platform
issues).


3. Business Collaboration & Curriculum Design

- Partner with Business Unit and Practice Leaders to identify role-specific capability needs
- Co-design curriculum architecture spanning foundational AI literacy, tool-specific certification, and
applied/project-based learning.
- Blend external certification pathways (partner-provided) with internally built modules addressing
organization-specific tools, use cases, and client delivery contexts.
- Ensure curriculum is continuously validated against real project/delivery needs via SME input and
delivery leadership feedback loops - not designed in a vacuum.
- Own the learning experience design: cohort structuring, learning journeys, blended formats (self-paced,
instructor-led, hands-on labs, capstone projects), and platform/LMS integration.


4. ROI & Business Case Development
- Define and track measurable outcomes for all capability-building investments - completion rates,
certification pass rates, badge issuance, deployment readiness, and downstream business impact
(e.g., billable utilization of certified talent, win-rate impact on AI-related deals, client satisfaction on AI
delivered engagements).
- Build the business case and cost-benefit model for capability investments, including license costs,
platform fees, SME/trainer time, and opportunity cost of learning hours.
- Establish a measurement framework (Kirkpatrick or equivalent) to assess learning effectiveness at
reaction, learning, behavior, and business-impact levels.
- Present ROI dashboards and impact narratives to leadership, linking capability development spend
directly to revenue enablement, delivery quality, and partner-tier progression (e.g., OpenAI Select
Advanced Elite tier requirements).
- Recommend course corrections, reallocation, or scale-up of programs based on data-driven insight.


5. Subject Matter Expertise (SME)
- Maintain deep, current knowledge of the AI/LLM ecosystem - foundation model providers, partner
certification frameworks, agentic AI, FDE/Forward Deployed practices, prompt engineering, and
enterprise AI deployment patterns.
- Act as an internal SME and point of escalation for curriculum content accuracy, partner program
requirements, and emerging AI skill taxonomies.
- Represent the organization in partner enablement calls, curriculum advisory sessions, and industry
forums to stay ahead of program changes (e.g., shifts in OpenAI's certification structure, new Anthropic
Academy offerings).
- Mentor and upskill internal trainers/facilitators to ensure consistent, high-quality delivery of technical
content.


6. Project Management
- Own end-to-end program management for all capability-building initiatives - planning, resourcing,
timelines, risk management, and stakeholder communication.
- Manage concurrent workstreams (e.g., multiple partner cohorts running in parallel, each with different
license validity windows, e.g., 30-day expiry constraints) without slippage.
- Set up and maintain governance artifacts: project plans, RAID logs, status dashboards, and milestone
tracking visible to leadership.
- Coordinate cross-functional dependencies (IT/LMS teams, partner admins, finance for licensing spend,
HR for workforce data) to ensure smooth program execution.
- Manage vendor/partner relationships operationally - license provisioning, admin access, cohort
scheduling, and issue escalation.


7. Team Management
- Build, lead, and develop a team of L&D professionals, instructional designers, and/or program
coordinators supporting the AI capability agenda.
- Set clear goals, growth plans, and performance expectations for the team; conduct regular 1:1s,
feedback, and career development conversations.
- Foster a culture of curiosity, continuous learning, and ownership within the team - modeling the same
AI fluency the team is enabling across the organization.
- Manage capacity planning and workload distribution across concurrent programs and cohorts.
- Identify and develop future L&D/AI capability leaders through delegation and stretch assignments.


Required Qualifications

- 8 -15 years of overall experience, with at least 3-5 years in Learning & Development, Talent
Transformation, or AI/Technology Enablement roles.
- Proven experience designing and scaling large cohort-based certification or upskilling programs (100+
learners), ideally involving external technology partners (cloud, AI/LLM providers, or SaaS platforms).
- Strong understanding of the AI/LLM partner ecosystem - familiarity with OpenAI, Anthropic, data, cloud,
or equivalent partner network structures, certification frameworks, and enablement models is highly
preferred.
- Demonstrated experience building ROI/business case frameworks for L&D or transformation
investments.
- Strong stakeholder management experience with senior leadership (VP/CxO level) and cross
functional teams.
- Experience with instructional design methodologies and modern learning platforms/LMS.
- People management experience - has led teams of 3+ direct or indirect reports.


Preferred Skills & Attributes

- Executive presence with the ability to influence without direct authority.
- Analytical mindset - comfortable building and defending data-driven ROI narratives.
- High personal curiosity about AI - actively uses AI tools and stays current with the fast-evolving
landscape.
- Structured project management discipline combined with comfort operating in ambiguity (partner
programs, certification structures, and timelines shift frequently in this space).
- Strong written and verbal communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution - this role is not purely strategic or purely
operational.

jobDescription:
Location - Hyderabad

Employment Type - Full-Time

Tech Stack - MERN (MongoDB Express React Node.js) AWS

Domain - Cybersecurity AI-Native Platforms SaaS

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Product Development Manager will own the full product development lifecycle for Nopal Cyber's AI-native service delivery platform. You will lead a sizeable team of full stack and AI engineers across the N360 web platform and Nopal Go Mobile App, ensuring seamless delivery of secure, scalable, and intelligent features built on a MERN stack deployed on AWS infrastructure.

This is a high-impact role that sits at the intersection of engineering leadership, product strategy, and cybersecurity service delivery, demanding someone who can architect solutions as comfortably as they can roadmap and lead people.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Product Platform Leadership: Own the end-to-end development roadmap for the N360 Web App and Nopal Go Mobile App, aligning product milestones with business objectives.
  • Define and prioritize the product backlog, translating cybersecurity use cases and customer requirements into actionable engineering sprints.
  • Champion AI-native features : including threat intelligence automation, ai-enabled EASM, AI SOC, AI attack surface reduction, Agentic AI pen testing, adaptive risk scoring, and intelligent alerting from concept to commission.
  • Collaborate with technology leadership, security architects, and business stakeholders to shape platform strategy and feature direction.

Engineering Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a sizeable cross-functional team of developers (full-stack, mobile, AI, DevSecOps) across agile development cycles.
  • Establish and uphold engineering best practices : code quality, peer reviews, CI/CD pipelines, and secure development standards (SAST/DAST).
  • Drive sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives, and release governance to maintain predictable, high-quality delivery cadences.
  • Identify and resolve technical bottlenecks, manage risks, and escalate blockers proactively.

Technical Delivery MERN on AWS

  • Oversee architecture decisions for scalable MERN-based services, APIs, microservices, data pipelines, and real-time processing layers.
  • Ensure the AWS infrastructure (EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, RDS, S3, CloudFront, WAF) supports platform SLAs, reliability, and security compliance.
  • Drive DevSecOps integration : infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/CDK), automated security checks, and zero-downtime deployment strategies.
  • Lead performance benchmarking, capacity planning, and cost optimization across cloud resources.

Cybersecurity Compliance

  • Integrate cybersecurity best practices into every stage of the SDLC including threat modelling, secure code review, Secure SDLC and penetration testing.
  • Ensure platform adherence to relevant compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, GDPR, EU Act as applicable).
  • Collaborate with the service delivery operations team to embed real-world threat intelligence into platform feature development.
  • Evaluate and incorporate AI/ML-driven security capabilities : AI incident response, AI attack surface management, AI-native service delivery operations, anomaly detection, behavioral analytics.

Stakeholder Delivery Management

  • Serve as the primary engineering point of contact for product, sales, and service delivery teams.
  • Produce clear executive-level reporting on delivery progress, KPIs, technical backlogs, and platform health.
  • Manage third-party vendor relationships, open-source integrations, and API partnerships where relevant.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 10-12 years of software development experience, with at least 3-5 years in a product/engineering management or technical lead role.
  • Proven track record managing agile engineering teams of 8+ developers through full product delivery cycles.
  • Strong hands-on proficiency with MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js) capable of reviewing architecture and code with authority.
  • Deep AWS expertise EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, RDS/DynamoDB, S3, CloudWatch, IAM, and WAF.
  • Experience with CI/CD tooling GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, or equivalent.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage both web (React SPA) and mobile (React Native or similar) development streams simultaneously.
  • Strong engineering judgment in API design, microservices architecture, database optimization, and system scalability.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum frameworks and tools such as Jira, Confluence, or Linear.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Cybersecurity domain knowledge familiarity with SOC operations, SIEM/SOAR platforms, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, or security service delivery.
  • Hands-on experience building AI/ML-integrated products LLM APIs, anomaly detection models, or automated decision pipelines.
  • Knowledge of OWASP Top 10, secure coding standards, and DevSecOps practices.
  • Exposure to compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST, or CIS Controls.
  • Experience with React Native for mobile development (Nopal Go).
  • Relevant certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, CISSP, CISM, PMP, or equivalent are a strong plus.

LEADERSHIP SOFT SKILLS

  • Exceptional communicator able to translate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and vice versa.
  • High ownership mindset proactive problem-solver who runs toward ambiguity, not away from it.
  • Strong people leader fosters a culture of psychological safety, continuous learning, and engineering excellence.
  • Data-driven decision maker uses metrics (velocity, defect rates, MTTR, NPS) to inform priorities and improvements.
  • Collaborative and cross-functional builds trusted relationships across product, design, security, and business teams.

Founded in 2019 by IIT Roorkee alumni, Fam is backed by some of the most respected investors around the world like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (Sequoia Capital) India, Venture Highway, Global Founder s Capital and the likes of Kunal Shah, Amrish Rao as angel investors.

  • Clear communicator who can turn raw numbers into simple, actionable insights.

  • Exposure to large-scale databases (BigQuery, Redshift, ClickHouse, etc.)

  • Write SQL queries to pull and analyze payments data (transactions, success/failure rates, settlements).

title: Compliance Program Manager
jobDescription:
Meet the Team

The Compliance Program Management (CPM) team enables global market access for Cisco products by ensuring compliance requirements are met throughout the product lifecycle. We collaborate with Engineering, Business Units, EMC, Safety, Mechanical Engineering, Country Managers, Regulatory Agencies, and Corporate Compliance teams to secure country approvals, ensure product readiness, and support successful product launches worldwide.

As a Compliance Program Manager, you will drive compliance activities from product concept through First Hardware Ship (FHS) and sustainment. You will coordinate regulatory approvals, manage compliance deliverables, review product labels, oversee key milestones, and communicate compliance readiness to stakeholders and leadership.

Your Impact
  • Ensure Global Access: Validate that Cisco products meet regulatory requirements for all markets in which they are sold.
  • Lead Approvals: Manage country approval activities by collaborating with Country Managers, Regulatory Agencies, and Corporate Compliance teams.
  • Drive Milestones: Plan and execute compliance activities aligned with product development milestones, including DVT, AO, and First Hardware Ship (FHS).
  • Coordinate Compliance: Oversee EMC and Safety compliance activities, including obtaining and validating required test reports and supporting documentation.
  • Manage Workflows: Submit and manage country approval requests through Cisco compliance systems and approval workflows.
  • Ensure Accuracy: Review and approve product labels to ensure proper Product IDs (PIDs) and country approval logos are included prior to release.
  • Foster Collaboration: Partner with Mechanical Product Engineers, Engineering PMs, Business Units, EMC, Safety, and Marketing teams to drive compliance readiness.
  • Monitor Risks: Track compliance risks, approval status, and certification timelines, ensuring issues are communicated and escalated effectively.
  • Present Results: Prepare and present compliance status, timelines, risks, and readiness information during Executive Commitment (EC) reviews.
  • Maintain Documentation: Manage compliance documentation, certification records, test reports, and approval artifacts throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Drive Innovation: Implement process improvements and leverage automation and AI tools to enhance compliance execution, reporting, and operational efficiency.
Minimum Qualifications
  • Bachelor s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Operations Management, Project Management, Compliance, Supply Chain, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in Program Management, Compliance Management, Regulatory Programs, Product Operations, Project Management, Quality Systems, or related functions.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional programs involving multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.
  • Experience managing project schedules, milestones, risks, and action items.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Experience presenting program status and risks to leadership teams.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently and drive execution.
Preferred Qualifications
  • 7+ years of experience in Compliance Program Management, Regulatory Affairs, Product Compliance, Quality Management, Program Management, or related fields.
  • Experience supporting hardware development programs and product lifecycle management.
  • Familiarity with EMC, Safety, Regulatory, Certification, or Country Approval processes.
  • Experience supporting product launches in a global environment.
  • Knowledge of compliance documentation, certification requirements, and audit readiness practices.
  • Experience preparing Executive Commitment (EC) presentations and leadership updates.
  • Experience using compliance, workflow, and project management systems.
  • PMP, Agile, Lean Six Sigma, Quality, Compliance, or related certifications.
  • Experience leveraging Microsoft Copilot or other AI productivity tools to improve reporting, communication, and operational efficiency.

Why Cisco

At Cisco, we re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Senior Solution Architect AI Solutions PreSales
jobDescription:
This person will lead the design of AI-led and AI-enabled enterprise solutions from sales qualification through contract award. Partnering with Sales and clients, the role will translate business requirements into scalable solution architectures and compelling RFP/proposal responses. The position is revenue-facing, with success measured by solution quality and conversion of opportunities into signed business. The architect will guide delivery teams post-award to ensure alignment between the proposed and delivered solution. Strong enterprise application/platform expertise is essential, with the ability to identify where AI creates genuine business value and where conventional solutions are more appropriate.

Key Responsibilities:

Advisory and Thought Partnership

  • Serve as a principal technical consultant throughout the sales lifecycle, collaborating with stakeholders to refine business problems prior to architectural mapping.
  • Evaluate client infrastructure, data maturity, and operational workflows to architect pragmatic and sustainable AI implementation roadmaps.
  • Provide expert guidance on the functional utility and constraints of AI, distinguishing between high-value AI use cases and areas where traditional methods excel.
  • Enhance the organization's market presence by contributing to executive briefings, industry workshops, and thought leadership collateral regarding AI in education.
  • Prioritize organizational change readiness and stakeholder alignment as critical success factors, ensuring technical architectures are sequenced for successful adoption.

Pre-Sales Support and Lead Response

  • Act as the lead technical authority for the sales organization on all high-potential enterprise opportunities.
  • Provide technical qualification, comprehensive effort modeling, and conceptual solutioning for incoming qualified leads.
  • Lead discovery sessions and deep-dive requirement gathering with prospective enterprise clients.
  • Advise leadership on technical feasibility, risk profiles, and strategic differentiation to improve competitive win rates.

Proposal and RFP Development

  • Develop high-quality technical content for RFPs, RFI responses, and detailed Statements of Work (SOWs).
  • Deconstruct complex bid requirements to align organizational capabilities with client needs, identifying strategic build or partner opportunities.
  • Produce sophisticated AI architecture visualizations, technical narratives, and operational assumptions for client-facing submissions.
  • Define robust positions on data privacy, model governance, and ethical AI mitigation to satisfy rigorous procurement and security reviews.
  • Collaborate across legal, finance, and delivery teams to ensure technical solutions remain consistent with commercial objectives and timelines.
  • Optimize bid turnaround by maintaining a centralized repository of validated architectural patterns and solution templates.

Solution Design and Architecture

  • Contextualize requirements within specific industry domains, including EdTech, publishing, Life Sciences, BFSI, and manufacturing.
  • Architect modular, AI-centric enterprise solutions designed to solve business challenges within complex technical constraints.
  • Deploy optimized AI methodologies, ranging from RAG and LLM applications to agentic workflows and traditional ML as required.
  • Integrate rigorous evaluation frameworks, human-in-the-loop protocols, and safety guardrails as foundational elements of the system design.
  • Establish comprehensive integration frameworks, data lineage, and infrastructure requirements for end-to-end delivery.
  • Analyze buy-vs-build scenarios to recommend the most efficient and scalable deployment strategy.
  • Quantify and articulate the trade-offs between accuracy, latency, and operational costs for AI-driven approaches.
  • Engineer holistic enterprise ecosystems including non-functional requirements (SLAs, scalability, observability) and secure integrations with legacy systems (CRM, ERP, LMS) via robust API patterns.
  • Harmonize traditional and AI technologies within a unified architecture to ensure optimal system performance and reliability.
  • Generate standardized EA artifacts, including reference architectures and decision records, aligned with client data and cloud governance.
  • Formulate Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) models, encompassing licensing, capacity planning, and scaling economics for AI solutions.

Prototyping and Demonstrations

  • Develop high-impact proofs of concept (PoCs) and functional prototypes to demonstrate the tangible value of AI solutions.
  • Deliver customized technical demonstrations that speak directly to the client's unique operational context and pain points.
  • Iterate on architectural designs based on stakeholder feedback from prototype reviews to ensure final submission alignment.

Client Presentation and Stakeholder Engagement

  • Present complex architectures to C-suite leadership, procurement committees, and specialized academic governing bodies.
  • Champion technical strategies during bid reviews and provide evidence-based responses to technical clarifications.
  • Address concerns regarding AI ethics, IP protection, and data security with technical depth and industry-specific insight.
  • Calibrate technical communication to suit varied audiences, from business stakeholders to deep-technical and procurement specialists.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience in Solution Architecture, Technical Pre-Sales, or Solution Engineering, with strong client-facing and revenue-linked exposure.
  • Proven expertise architecting large-scale, mission-critical enterprise platforms, across both AI and non-AI solutions, with strong integration, API, cloud, data, security, IAM, and DevOps capabilities.
  • Hands-on experience delivering production-grade AI solutions, including LLMs, RAG, agentic/multi-agent workflows, prompt/context engineering, evaluation, guardrails, and human oversight.
  • Strong understanding of Responsible AI, privacy, IP, bias, transparency, and compliance, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, DPDP, HIPAA/GxP, security, and data residency.
  • Proven ability to lead technical proposals/RFPs, client-facing POCs/prototypes, multi-vendor bids, and advise senior stakeholders on AI strategy, adoption, and organizational readiness.
  • Experience with enterprise learning technology including LMS/LXP, SCORM, xAPI, LTI, WCAG 2.2, and Section 508; exposure to academic/institutional governance is preferred.
  • Excellent technical writing, presentations, stakeholder advisory, Agile/Scrum, and modern front-end/rapid AI prototyping skills, with public contributions to AI/learning technology preferred.
  • Bachelors degree in CS/Engineering or equivalent; cloud certification (AWS/Azure/GCP), Scrum certification, and TOGAF/Enterprise Architecture certification or equivalent experience preferred.

Job Description: Senior Cloud Data Architect (Data Engineering Focus)

Experience Level: 10+ Years

Engagement: Contract / Fractional Lead (1620 Hours/Week)

Primary Tech Stack: Snowflake DLH, dbt, SQL, Python, Pimcore 11 (Integration), Docker/Containerization, CI/CD DevOps, Data Observability & Monitoring

Role Summary

We are seeking a Senior Cloud Data Architect with a strong Data Engineering background to drive the cloud architecture, pipeline engineering, and upstream data quality for our enterprise Data Lakehouse (Snowflake) and its integration with our Master Data Management platform (Pimcore 11).

In this role, you will bridge technical execution with business architecturebuilding scalable Snowflake pipelines, defining robust Data Quality (DQ) framework rules, and partnering closely with our MDM Lead and cross-functional teams to ensure seamless data flows and operational efficiency.

Core Responsibilities

1. Data Lakehouse Architecture & Pipeline Engineering

  • Architect, build, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines connecting Snowflake Data Lakehouse layers (RAW, PROCESSED, CURATED) with external applications and MDM systems.
  • Oversee data transformation logic, dbt models/snapshots, SCD Type 2 historical tracking, and surrogate key hashing mechanisms.
  • Define resilient ingestion patterns for Change Data Capture (CDC), transaction log parsing for hard deletes, and cross-system entity reconciliation.

2. Integration & Upstream Data Modeling

  • Partner directly with the MDM Lead to align Snowflake curated layer schemas with Pimcore 11 data classes and target object models.
  • Establish clear source-to-target mapping specifications, data contracts, and survivorship/golden record staging logic upstream of MDM ingestion.
  • Evaluate structural options (flattened vs. relational header/split models) to optimize query performance and API payload delivery.

3. Data Governance, Quality, Observability & Exception Handling

  • Design and implement automated Data Quality (DQ) profiling, validation checks, and bad record routing across raw and curated layers.
  • Implement data observability metrics (freshness, volume anomalies, schema drift, pipeline SLA tracking) to ensure data reliability.
  • Map complete end-to-end data lineage, column-level provenance, and cross-layer reconciliation counts.

4. Technical Leadership, DevOps & Containerization

  • Guide environment setups, Docker containerization, and CI/CD deployment pipelines for data assets and integrations.
  • Translate business requirements into technical mapping specifications, architecture blueprints, and technical documentation.
  • Lead architectural alignment sessions with cross-functional engineering leads (DLH, CRM, ERP) to ensure system compatibility and performance.

Required Qualifications & Technical Skills

  • Experience: 10+ years of hands-on experience in Cloud Data Architecture, Data Engineering, and Enterprise Data Warehousing.
  • Cloud Data Warehousing: Deep expertise in Snowflake architecture, dbt, query performance tuning, zero-copy cloning, RBAC security, and data sharing.
  • ETL, Data Modeling & Languages: Expert-level SQL, Python, dimensional modeling (SCD2, star schemas, surrogate keys, MD5 hashing), and batch/streaming data patterns.
  • Integrations & MDM Awareness: Strong experience integrating lakehouses with MDM or enterprise software (Pimcore, Reltio, Informatica, etc.) via REST/GraphQL APIs, webhooks, and event-driven architectures.
  • DevOps, Observability & Containerization: Practical experience with Docker/VM containerized environments, CI/CD deployment, and data pipeline monitoring/observability tooling.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Excellent technical communication skills, with a proven ability to lead architecture discussions with senior engineering teams and business stakeholders alike.

Compensation:

  • Hourly rate of INR 1,250 with working of minimum 16 hours per week leading to INR20,000 per week
  • Working from Home
  • Immediate start
  • You can work part time

descriptionFromApi:
Agentic AI, Generative AI, and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are key markets for NVIDIA. Researchers and developers actively embrace full-stack optimizations to accelerate their workloads and research. To help them onboard Accelerated Computing, NVIDIA leads a series of tech events, including Deep Learning Institute, hackathons, and bootcamps, along with its partners. Hackathons are short-typically week-long-intensive coding sessions where experienced mentors team up with groups of researchers and data scientists to guide them in accelerating or optimizing their projects using accelerated infrastructure and enterprise-grade software, across a variety of programming models, frameworks, and tools.

We are looking for a Senior Developer Advocate Engineer to own technical engagements for a rapidly growing program of NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute, Open Hackathons, and Bootcamps focused on the use of AI in a research and production environment. In this position, you will closely collaborate with developers to help adopt the NVIDIA accelerated computing stack (CPU and GPU technologies) for their work, optimize code and AI workflows, and build a growing community. You will build strategic relationships with our partners, mentor at hackathons, and help craft materials to educate attendees and prepare them for hackathons. Do you have a passion for community-based development, connecting people, and mentoring If so, we would like to speak with you right away!

What you ll be doing:

  • Stay abreast of the latest developments in Agentic AI, Generative AI, and develop proof-of-concept solutions for real-world applications.

  • Build and refine training materials and mentor team members solving real-world problems using NVIDIA NeMo , NVIDIA NIM , NVIDIA NemoClaw, and related stacks to create simulations, digital twins, and robotics workflows, etc.

  • Collaborate and provide feedback to NVIDIA product teams to help with product adoption, bugs, feature requests, and additional activities through our hackathon program.

  • Promote through publishing blogs and papers, facilitating presentations, and using other media that convey the impact of the work accomplished by teams at the hackathons.

  • Mentor developers and researchers to integrate NVIDIA technology to define architectures, compute footprints, test plans, and rollout strategies.

  • Strategize, identify, and assess potential sites, mentors, and key applications for NVIDIA DLI, Open Hackathons and Bootcamps program.

  • Write comprehensive internal feedback reports and find opportunities for improvement.

What we need to see:

  • Masters degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or relevant field (or equivalent experience).

  • 12+ years of relevant enterprise experience in developing Agentic AI, Generative AI, and Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions at scale, including synthetic data generation, evaluation, benchmarking, inference optimization, and deployment.

  • Fluent in using the NVIDIA accelerated computing stack for HPC and AI workloads.

  • Capability to think strategically, while jumping directly into day-to-day event and account management.

  • Ability to thrive in a highly dynamic environment and to lead change through multi-functional teamwork.

  • Proven ability to understand partners goals and distill that feedback into an action plan that addresses core needs.

  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience in deploying and managing data center-scale applications with AI toolchains.

  • Active OSS contributions in Agentic AI, Generative AI.

  • Experience in facilitating and instructing at group training events.

Job Summary
You will build and lead AHEAD s combined Research, Insights Design CoE - establishing the team s operating model, research methodology, design standards, quality governance, and delivery engine. This is a player-coach role that combines hands-on research execution and design excellence with stakeholder partnership, practice-building, and people leadership. You will be both an intellectual anchor and creative authority for the team, and a credible thought partner for AHEAD s senior consulting and sales leadership.
Your work will directly shape how AHEAD s consulting teams understand markets, position against competitors, plan for accounts, win complex enterprise technology deals - and how sharply those ideas and insights are expressed to CXO audiences through consulting-grade visual storytelling.
Responsibilities Research Delivery Insights
  • Create and own end-to-end delivery accountability for AHEADs full research product stack like Market Size Outlook, Industry/Technology POVs, Account Intelligence Packs, Competitive Profiles Battlecards, Buying Behaviour Analysis, Capability Heatmaps, Benchmark Reports etc
  • Synthesize intelligence from primary research and secondary research via tier-1 analyst platforms (e.g. Gartner, Everest Group, Forrester, IDC, Avasant etc), business databases (e.g.Hoovers, AlphaSense etc), and proprietary sources into crisp, executive-ready insight narratives.
  • Lead competitive intelligence strategy and translate findings into actionable pursuit positioning.
  • Drive account-level intelligence to support strategic account planning, C-suite engagement personalization, and opportunity identification for AHEADs consulting and sales teams.
  • Conduct peer review of analyst-produced research; enforce quality standards and provide structured developmental feedback across all deliverables.
  • Advisory Engagements: Support pursuit engagements by delivering market insights, competitive benchmarking, and strategic guidance based on proprietary research and market intelligence.
CoE Build-Out Team Leadership
  • Establish and operationalize the Research Insights centre - defining intake processes, research methodology, turnaround benchmarks, quality review protocols, and governance frameworks from the ground up.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Research Analysts /Sr Research Analysts; build a high-performance culture grounded in intellectual rigour, delivery excellence, and continuous learning.
  • Design competency frameworks, structured onboarding programs, and career progression pathways for the research team; actively mentor analysts in their professional growth.
  • Establish innovative research processes, methodologies and frameworks for structuring and analysing the data to develop impactful insights at a quality that is repeatable and is continually improved
  • Build and govern the teams knowledge repository: standardized research templates, source libraries, reusable intelligence assets, and a living research calendar aligned to consulting priorities.
  • Manage team utilization, workload distribution, and delivery economics; provide regular performance reporting to senior leadership.
Stakeholder Partnership Consulting Enablement
  • Serve as the primary research interface for AHEADs onsite consulting, sales, practice, and deal teams - translating strategic business questions and pursuit needs into structured, hypothesis-led research briefs.
  • Proactively anticipate intelligence needs across the full pursuit lifecycle: from opportunity identification and qualification through to proposal development, deal shaping, and win/loss review.
  • Present research findings and insight packages to senior internal stakeholders; provide strategic context and actionable recommendations, not just data.
  • Manage the custom research request pipeline; balance recurring standard reports with bespoke, high-urgency consulting support while maintaining delivery quality.
  • Partner with onsite consulting leaders during workshops to validate research priorities, align report formats to field requirements, and institutionalize feedback loops.
Methodology, Tools Innovation

jobDescription:
From day one, you ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.
What You ll Do
  • Lead modernization efforts for core APIs and platform interfaces that support AI-native workflows and automated consumers.
  • Define and drive company-wide standards for AI-ready APIs, including deterministic behavior, schema consistency, validation, observability, versioning, and operational safeguards.
  • Refactor and evolve legacy systems to support structured machine consumption, orchestration layers, MCP integrations, and scalable agent workflows.
  • Identify and resolve API inconsistencies such as non-standard error handling, hidden side effects, ambiguous data models, and weak contract enforcement.
  • Design backend systems and APIs capable of supporting high-concurrency automated traffic patterns, orchestration loops, and resilient distributed workflows.
  • Establish architectural guardrails including idempotency protections, advanced rate controls, validation strategies, authorization patterns, and failure containment mechanisms.
  • Partner with AI orchestration teams, platform engineering, and domain engineering organizations to enable scalable integration patterns across ABC s ecosystem.
  • Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance across multiple engineering organizations while helping shape long-term modernization strategy.
  • Lead design reviews, mentor senior engineers, and help elevate engineering standards and architectural maturity across the company.
  • Develop pragmatic modernization strategies that balance ideal future-state architecture with operational realities, production constraints, and incremental delivery goals.
  • Drive alignment between platform architecture, API strategy, and AI enablement initiatives across the organization without disrupting existing product and operational roadmaps.
What This Is Not
  • Not building isolated greenfield services that do not connect to core business systems.
  • Not a traditional feature-delivery role focused primarily on frontend or UI-driven requirements.
  • Not incremental bug fixing this is a strategic modernization and re-architecting effort focused on core platform interfaces and machine interoperability.
What You ll Need
  • Typically 10+ years of software engineering experience with deep expertise in backend systems, distributed architectures, and platform engineering.
  • Demonstrated success architecting, building, and evolving complex APIs and distributed systems at scale.
  • Proven experience modernizing legacy platforms and mission-critical production systems without disrupting business operations.
  • Deep understanding of API contracts, schema design, deterministic behavior, observability, validation, versioning, authentication, authorization, and integration reliability.
  • Strong systems-thinking mindset with the ability to understand platform-wide architectural implications and downstream effects on AI agents and orchestration systems.
  • Experience driving technical strategy and influencing architectural direction across multiple teams and organizations.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals across resiliency, scalability, performance, operational excellence, and distributed systems design.
  • Ability to operate as a senior technical leader and subject matter expert within a complex engineering organization.
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and leading architectural discussions that improve platform quality and long-term maintainability.
  • Pragmatic decision-making skills with the ability to balance strategic architecture goals with delivery timelines and existing system constraints.
  • Strong collaboration skills and a One Team mindset across platform, infrastructure, AI, and product engineering organizations.
And It s Great to Have
  • Experience with gRPC, Protocol Buffers, GraphQL, or other strongly typed API frameworks.
  • Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP), AI orchestration systems, or building structured interfaces for LLM-powered tools and agents.
  • Experience with event-driven architectures, workflow orchestration systems, and high-throughput distributed platforms.
  • Experience establishing engineering standards, platform governance models, or enterprise-wide modernization initiatives.
  • Experience designing highly observable systems with advanced traffic management, resiliency, and operational safeguards.
  • Experience supporting AI-native product architectures or machine-driven integration ecosystems.
What Success Looks Like
  • Core APIs are highly predictable, reliable, and scalable for both application teams and automated AI consumers.
  • AI orchestration teams can integrate new agents and workflows with minimal custom integration logic or workaround layers.
  • Platform standards for AI-ready APIs are clearly defined, practical to adopt, and consistently implemented across engineering organizations.
  • Core systems remain stable, secure, and performant under increasing levels of automated and concurrent machine-driven traffic.
  • Engineering teams have clear paved-path architectural guidance for building and evolving APIs that support long-term AI strategy.
  • Modernization initiatives improve platform quality, reduce integration complexity, and accelerate AI capability delivery across ABC.
  • The organization has a sustainable architectural foundation capable of supporting future AI-native platform evolution.
Why This Matters
ABC Fitness is building toward an AI-native future where intelligent agents, orchestration systems, and automation platforms can securely and reliably interact with our products and services at scale. The effectiveness of those systems depends on the quality, predictability, and reliability of the APIs that power them.
You are not simply modernizing APIs you are helping build the operational foundation that allows AI systems to safely and effectively interact with ABC s products, workflows, and data ecosystem at scale.
WHAT S IN IT FOR YOU:
  • Purpose led company with a Values focused culture Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
  • Time Off competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year

The Senior Material Engineer will be responsible for developing and implementing strategies related to selection, processing a wide range of products and raw materials. Independently studies structures and chemical properties of various materials required by RD to enhance existing products. Identifies and solves problems related to performance or selection of materials, including failure analysis.

  • Qualification of electronic components and associated processes
  • AI, digitalization, data analytics, and automation initiatives
  • Strong presentation skills

Join our Energy department in India

COWI Renewable Energy, of which we are a part, has offices in Scandinavia, UK and Germany and in Poland. We provide consultancy services to our customers on the planning, designing, and optimization of energy systems worldwide.

In this position as a Power System Engineer (AIS and GIS Substations), you will join our international team of experts and work on challenging and innovative projects. Your key responsibilities will include modeling, analyzing, and designing AIS and GIS Substations, as well as developing future strategies for our clients.

The AIS and GIS Substations will be engaged in feasibility studies and master planning, assessing technical and economic factors to optimize overhead lines and their design. This role supports the development of reliable and efficient power transmission solutions tailored to each project s unique requirements.

Furthermore, on a day-to-day basis you will:

  • Prepare technical specifications and documentation for primary circuits of AIS and GIS substations up to 420 kV.
  • Perform essential engineering calculations, including grounding and lightning protection studies.
  • Produce building and detailed design documentation and support the permitting process.
  • Conduct feasibility studies, master planning, and prepare technical reports.
  • Provide technical consulting and advisory support to customers.
  • Collaborate with clients through meetings, strategic planning, and business trips.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

  • Broad understanding of high-voltage substations in range of 22- 420 kV
  • Strong competence in high-voltage installation and equipment, both AIS and GIS
  • Experience with:

Looking for a technical candidate with Agentic AI experience and strong hands-on experience with Python.

Job Description

highly skilled AI / GenAI Architect to lead the design, development, and end-to-end operationalization of our AI infrastructure. In this role, you will be the driving force behind our agent-based architecture, responsible not only for building cutting-edge GenAI agents but also for managing the "run" ensuring robust infrastructure, seamless production maintenance, and continuous optimization. If you excel at bridging the gap between innovative AI research and reliable, scalable enterprise operations (LLMOps/MLOps), this role is for you.

10+ years of experience in Software/System Architecture or Cloud Infrastructure.

3+ years of specific, hands-on experience deploying Machine Learning or Generative AI models into production.

Proven track record of managing the operational "run" of live software/AI systems.

Job Responsibilities

  • Architecture Agent Development
  • System Design: Design, develop, and scale an enterprise-grade AI and agent-based architecture.
  • Agent Creation: Build, test, and deploy new autonomous and semi-autonomous AI agents tailored to specific business use cases (e.g., using LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI).
  • Integration: Seamlessly integrate GenAI modules, Large Language Models (LLMs), Vector Databases, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines into existing enterprise applications.
  • Infrastructure "Run" Management (LLMOps)
  • Infrastructure Provisioning: Provision, configure, and maintain the underlying cloud and AI infrastructure required to support LLM inference, vector storage, and agent orchestration.
  • Production Maintenance: Take full ownership of the "run" phase of AI implementation. Ensure production agents are highly available, scalable, and secure.
  • Strategy Governance: Develop and implement a comprehensive strategy for the lifecycle management, versioning, and continuous maintenance of AI modules and agents in a live production environment.
  • CI/CD Pipeline: Build and manage automated deployment pipelines for AI models and agent updates to ensure zero-downtime deployments.
  • Monitoring, Evaluation Refinement
  • Performance Tracking: Implement robust monitoring systems to track the health, latency, and throughput of production agents.
  • Quality Safety Control: Continuously monitor outputs for model drift, accuracy degradation, bias, and hallucinations
  • Continuous Improvement: Establish feedback loops to refine prompts, fine-tune models, update RAG knowledge bases, and improve overall agent performance based on real-world production data.

Technical Expertise:

  • AI/GenAI Ecosystem: Deep expertise in LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models like LLaMA), prompting frameworks, and agentic orchestration frameworks (LangChain, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel).
  • Programming: Strong proficiency in Python and relevant backend frameworks (FastAPI, Flask, etc.).
  • Data Storage: Experience with Vector Databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, Qdrant) and data pipelines for RAG setups.
  • Infrastructure Cloud: Hands-on experience provisioning and managing infrastructure on AWS, GCP, or Azure (Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker).
  • LLMOps / MLOps: Proven experience with AI/ML monitoring and evaluation tools (e.g., LangSmith, Weights Biases, TruLens, MLflow).
  • Architecture Pattern-Event Broker Orecherstor /SupervisorPattern
  • Dashboard- Grafana
